title: Winter Doldrums
summary:
2021 starts with poor tanker rates across the board
2021 is not off to a great start. Usually, the winter months are good for tanker rates, but not this year. A review of the daily market rates shows low Worldscale (WS) assessments, which lead to very low TCE (time charter equivalent) earnings.
